title: Expiration Notice and Rollover Calendar — Residential Natural Gas Supply Terms
content:
For every Residential Natural Gas Supply plan the compliance calendar fixes when the two expiration notices fall, how long a renewal election is still honoured after rollover, which plan an expiring term rolls into, and how long the expiring rate is held when notices were late.

| Plan | Initial renewal notice: earliest point (calendar days before contract end) | Initial renewal notice: latest point (calendar days before contract end) | Final options notice: latest point (calendar days before contract end) | Post-expiry renewal grace period after rollover (calendar days) | Rollover plan | Late-notice hold: billing cycles the expiring rate is held after a late-notice rollover |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Gas Monthly Variable | 60 | 45 | 30 | 30 | Beacon Ridge Gas Monthly Variable | 2 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Capped Variable 12 | 60 | 45 | 30 | 30 | Beacon Ridge Gas Monthly Variable | 2 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 12 | 60 | 45 | 30 | 30 | Beacon Ridge Gas Monthly Variable | 2 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 24 | 60 | 45 | 30 | 30 | Beacon Ridge Gas Monthly Variable | 2 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 36 | 60 | 45 | 30 | 30 | Beacon Ridge Gas Monthly Variable | 2 |
| Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 12 | 60 | 45 | 30 | 30 | Beacon Ridge Gas Monthly Variable | 2 |
| Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 24 | 60 | 45 | 30 | 30 | Beacon Ridge Gas Monthly Variable | 2 |

### Calendar reading (hypothetical contract end date)

For a term ending on 30 September, 60 calendar days before is 1 August and 45 calendar days before is 16 August, so the initial renewal notice falls in the span from 1 August to 16 August; 30 calendar days before is 31 August, the latest point for the final options notice.

The rollover plan is the plan an expiring agreement converts to when no election is made: Beacon Ridge Gas Monthly Variable on every plan. The renewal grace figure is the number of calendar days after rollover during which a renewal election is still honoured.
